summary: Iteration 19 backend testing complete. 17/17 pytest tests passed after fixing one critical route-ordering bug in /app/backend/server.py where GET /receipts/advances was shadowed by GET /receipts/{rid}, always returning 404. Moved the /receipts/advances handler ahead of /receipts/{rid} and re-verified. All reference_no auto-derivation paths (invoice, sale-with-invoice, sale-without-invoice, collection, other/advance) and explicit override work correctly. Advance listing filters correctly by phone / customer_id and rejects missing params with 400. PATCH /receipts/{id} is admin-only (403 for employee) and auto-derives reference_no on source change. POST /invoices attach_receipt_ids correctly links same-customer advances, silently skips different-customer receipts, non-'other' source_type receipts, and receipts with an existing reference_no. Test data (receipts, invoices, auto-created sales, TEST19 customers) cleaned up in teardown.

critical.issue: Route was declared AFTER GET /api/receipts/{rid} in server.py so FastAPI matched the path-param route first and returned 404 'Not found' for every call. Fixed by moving the /receipts/advances handler above /receipts/{rid}. Reference: /app/backend/server.py around line 2903 (new position) — original duplicate at ~line 2961 replaced with hidden legacy stub.

action_items: Frontend note: any UI screens that previously called /api/receipts/advances would have been broken by the route-ordering bug — please have E1 verify the mobile receipt/advance selector screen now shows advances after this fix.

Consider deleting the placeholder stub route '/receipts/advances-legacy-removed' in server.py once E1 does a cleanup pass; it exists only to preserve the original code block position without duplicating the handler.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3292 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into modules (receipts, invoices, sales, collections, auth, etc.).
list_advance_receipts endpoint originally suffered a classic FastAPI route-ordering pitfall; add a note or a lint rule to catch specific paths declared after {param} paths on the same prefix.

attach_receipt_ids handling in create_invoice silently skips invalid receipts (different customer, non-advance) — this matches the spec but a debug log line would help admins understand why an attached receipt didn't get linked.

/app/backend/tests/test_iteration19_reference_no_advances.py (new pytest suite, 17 tests, autouse cleanup fixture)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 19 reference-no + advance-attach flow is green. If E1 refactors server.py, be careful to preserve route-ordering: specific paths (/receipts/advances) must be declared before path-parameter routes (/receipts/{rid}).
rca_of_issue: RCA — GET /api/receipts/advances 404: FastAPI matches routes in the order they are added to the router. get_receipt (GET /receipts/{rid}) was registered at line 2904 while list_advance_receipts (GET /receipts/advances) was registered at line 2961. Any request to /receipts/advances first hit /receipts/{rid} with rid='advances', which then failed the db.receipts.find_one lookup and returned HTTPException(404, 'Not found'). Reproduction: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' '$BACKEND_URL/api/receipts/advances?phone=91xxxxxxxxxx'` → 404 before fix, 200 with `{advances,count,total_amount}` after fix. Mitigation applied: moved list_advance_receipts_early above get_receipt in server.py.
